research_question: Does adding independent Classical Sanskrit training material reduce the observed +0.0776 CE held-out Sanskrit regression without degrading English, Hindi, or Code control domains?

hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Classical Sanskrit token addition does not produce delta_sa < 0.000 or causes control regression delta > +0.050 CE.
hypotheses.alternative_hypothesis: Classical Sanskrit token addition produces delta_sa <= -0.050 CE while preserving global CE <= 4.2900 and control deltas <= +0.020 CE.

experimental_arms.name: cpt_seed_42_reference
experimental_arms.description: Existing CPT model trained on 6 sources (no Sanskrit)

experimental_arms.name: sanskrit_augmented_cpt
experimental_arms.description: CPT trained on 85% existing corpus + 15% independent Classical Sanskrit

experimental_arms.name: volume_matched_control
experimental_arms.description: CPT trained on 85% existing corpus + 15% extra English/Hindi text

controls_and_invariants.optimizer: AdamW (lr=2e-4, weight_decay=0.01, linear warmup 50 steps, cosine decay)

partial_repair_negative_transfer.criteria: sanskrit_ce <= 4.3600 but hindi_ce or english_ce delta > +0.030
